honesty: Every entry here is a real trading business, club, service or public agency unless its status field says otherwise.
Nothing in this file was invented. Where a name could not be confirmed as still trading it carries confidence low and a note.
Coordinates marked coords_source ‘luke-repo-workbook’ come from Luke’s own place workbook and are entrance-approximate, not survey grade.
All employs figures and all peak_multiplier_estimate figures are modelling estimates for the simulation, not measured headcounts or measured trade data.

Opening hours carry one of four bases. ‘published’ means the business published them itself. ‘listed’ means somebody else published them: a directory, a council or a tourism body, which is real and citable and goes stale without anybody being told. ‘estimate’ means nobody published them and the week here is a plausible island pattern for the simulation to run on, shown to a player as the simulation’s own pattern in one line and never drawn as a week. ‘none’ means nobody published them and this pack carries no guess at them either: seven unverified days and no week at all.

Opening hours are only ever computed for a shopfront. hours_posture says which records are not one, and a record that is not one is never asked whether it is open: an Elders’ council, a Traditional Owner corporation, an ambulance station, a hall, a school and a ferry line do not open and shut, and a live open or shut sign over any of them would be this twin describing how somebody else runs.
Every hours block carries source, source_kind, checked and confidence. A business is only as open as its last check, and the twin says so on screen rather than implying knowledge it does not have.

What happens to a business in weather, on a shut beach, or when the barge did not run is modelled in src/systems/economy/hours.js and is never published by anybody. It is labelled modelled everywhere it surfaces.
